system.description: You turn a creature within 60' into living stone.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the stone cracks only on a 20.
outcomes.success: The creature takes 2d10 damage and is Restrained and Stupefied. At the start of each of its turns, the Dark Master rolls a d20 and the stone cracks on 18 or higher, ending the effect (a player character tests Toughness DR18 instead). A creature reduced to 0 HP while petrified is a statue, and shatters if struck again.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and the creature is Slowed on its next turn as stone creeps over it and falls away.
outcomes.ruin: Your own feet turn to stone: you are Restrained until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
